# Viola app icon

Nick’s locked pointer-and-rings artwork, supplied in viola-icon-handoff-2026-10-04.zip. The native SVG and these nine PNGs are copied byte-for-byte from the handoff. The source artwork is the existing Luma v4 icon, cropped viewBox 82 82 860 860. No redraw or extra mask. The signed Chromium engine logos remain unchanged; these files supply the visible native app and desktop icons.
